crudSummary.create: Create fulfillment dispatch jobs, assign partner courier tracking identifiers, and submit customer return or warranty claim requests.
crudSummary.read: Track real-time delivery lifecycle statuses (Processing, Shipped, In-Transit, Delivered), review courier logs, and inspect pending customer returns.
crudSummary.update: Update order fulfillment status, record Cash-on-Delivery (COD) collection milestones, and advance return ticket stages (Under Review, Approved, Completed).
crudSummary.delete: Cancel dispatch orders prior to courier handover and dismiss invalid or withdrawn customer return requests.

assignedErrors.name: Invalid Courier Tracking Identifier Format
assignedErrors.condition: Triggered when dispatch tracking identifier format is invalid or courier partner is unselected (Expected KB-LK-XXXXX, PX-LK-XXXXX, or DX-COL-XXXXX).
assignedErrors.message: Tracking identifier format invalid. Expected format: KB-LK-XXXXX, PX-LK-XXXXX, or DX-COL-XXXXX.

assignedErrors.name: Illegal Delivery Lifecycle State Transition
assignedErrors.condition: Triggered when attempting to transition an order status illegally (e.g., from 'Processing' directly to 'Delivered' without dispatch).
assignedErrors.message: Illegal delivery lifecycle transition from "Processing" to "Delivered". Lifecycle must follow: Processing -> Shipped -> In-Transit -> Delivered.

assignedErrors.name: Expired Return Window or Unfulfilled Order Claim
assignedErrors.condition: Triggered when a customer submits a return or warranty inspection for an order that has not yet been delivered or whose 14-day warranty claim window has elapsed.
assignedErrors.message: Cannot submit return/warranty claim for order "MM-2026-1003". The order status is currently "Processing". Returns are only permitted after successful delivery.

endpointsTested: GET /api/orders - List persistent saved orders with customer and status filters
POST /api/orders - Save new customer order, coordinate stock, invoices, and dispatch
GET /api/fulfillments - List courier dispatch records (Koombiyo, PromptX, Domex)
GET /api/fulfillments/:orderId - Fetch delivery checkpoints and live tracking timeline
POST /api/fulfillments/dispatch - Assign courier partner and tracking identifier
POST /api/returns - Submit customer return / warranty claim ticket
GET /api/returns - View list of warranty inspection tickets
PUT /api/returns/:ticketId - Advance ticket stage (Under Review -> Approved -> Completed)
